claim: exercisedb.dev now presents itself as AscendAPI, previously ExerciseDB.
The free V1 tier is 1,500 exercises with 180p GIFs and needs no authentication.
quote: 1,500 exercises with 180p GIFs. No authentication required, just call the hosted API directly.

claim: The free V1 endpoint is oss.exercisedb.dev/api/v1/exercises.
The free V1 endpoint reported a total of 1,500 exercises when read on October 22, 2026.
The free V1 endpoint returns success, a meta object with total and a nextCursor, and data.
A paid V1 tier on RapidAPI adds multi-resolution media, difficulty levels and exercise types.
quote: Enhanced data with multi-resolution media, difficulty levels, exercise types, and more.

claim: Free V1 media is 180p GIFs only; 360p to 1080p images and GIFs are on the paid RapidAPI tier.
quote: The free tier includes 180p GIFs only . Multi-resolution images and GIFs (360p–1080p) are available on the paid RapidAPI tier .

claim: The paid V1 tier's RapidAPI host is edb-with-gifs-and-images-by-ascendapi.p.rapidapi.com.
ExerciseDB V2 gives each exercise an MP4 demonstration video.
quote: Each exercise includes an MP4 demonstration video for in-app playback.

claim: The V2 record carries a videoUrl field.
quote: videoUrl | string | Exercise demonstration video URL

claim: AscendAPI's quickstart calls the V2 Basic plan completely free.
quote: Select the Basic plan it’s completely free:

claim: The free Basic plan includes 2,000 requests a month.
The free Basic plan includes 200 exercises in the library.
The free Basic plan includes exercise images and videos.
The free Basic plan needs no credit card.
V2 requests send X-RapidAPI-Key and X-RapidAPI-Host edb-with-videos-and-images-by-ascendapi.p.rapidapi.com.
The quickstart's first request searches exercises at /api/v1/exercises/search.
Both V2 tiers are accessed via RapidAPI, and free-tier media is watermarked.
quote: Both free and paid tiers are accessed via RapidAPI. The only difference is that free tier media is watermarked .

claim: AscendAPI's free plans are limited to 1,000 requests per hour per API key.
quote: All free plans include a limit of 1,000 requests per hour per API key.

claim: The exercisedb-api repository carries an AGPL-3.0 LICENSE file (a git clone on 2026-10-22 showed only README.md and LICENSE, last commit 2025-11-25).
